Searched for excerpts involving Mark, Todd, Zola, and Gordy and inspected multiple pages of the authorized Hachette and Penguin Random House opening text.

Searched the exact suicide-recollection quotation; no authoritative standalone source resolved its speaker, so its conversational wording and conflict with sustained third-person evidence were treated as a local character voice.
person_note: The controlling narrator is nonparticipating third person. Multiple Goodreads excerpts sustain external scene narration across Mark, Todd, Zola, Gordy, and other characters, while two authorized publisher excerpts independently show the same mode in the opening. The whole-book POV description explicitly confirms third-person omniscient narration and character-to-character shifts. The apparent first-person exceptions do not indicate alternating narration: q01588 is conversational character recollection, and q01589 is from the author's note. The remaining uncertainty is only the precise speaker of q01588, not the book-level person.
